check_execution_assignments_location_con.value:
(
        ("check_execution_assignments"."location" = 'local' and "check_execution_assignments"."probe_location_id" is null)
        or
        ("check_execution_assignments"."probe_location_id" is not null and "check_execution_assignments"."location" = "check_execution_assignments"."probe_location_id"::text)
      )

check_execution_assignments_claim_consis.name: check_execution_assignments_claim_consistent
check_execution_assignments_claim_consis.value:
("check_execution_assignments"."status" = 'RUNNING') =

check_execution_results_response_evidenc.name: check_execution_results_response_evidence_consistent
check_execution_results_response_evidenc.value:
(
        (("check_execution_results"."status_code" is null) = ("check_execution_results"."response_time_ms" is null))
        or
        ("check_execution_results"."status_code" is null and "check_execution_results"."response_time_ms" is not null and (
          ("check_execution_results"."stage" = 'CONNECT' and "check_execution_results"."reason" = 'CONNECTED')
          or
          ("check_execution_results"."stage" = 'DNS' and "check_execution_results"."reason"::text in ('RECORDS_MATCHED', 'NO_RECORDS', 'RECORD_MISMATCH'))
          or
          ("check_execution_results"."stage"::text = 'DOMAIN' and "check_execution_results"."reason"::text in ('DOMAIN_HEALTHY', 'DOMAIN_EXPIRING', 'DOMAIN_EXPIRED', 'DOMAIN_EXPIRATION_UNAVAILABLE'))
        ))
      )

check_regional_evaluations_terminal_cons.name: check_regional_evaluations_terminal_consistent

check_round_locations_identity_consisten.name: check_round_locations_identity_consistent

check_round_outbox_not_published_and_blo.name: check_round_outbox_not_published_and_blocked
check_round_outbox_not_published_and_blo.value: not ("check_round_outbox"."published_at" is not null and "check_round_outbox"."blocked_at" is not null)

check_round_outbox_terminal_claim_cleare.name: check_round_outbox_terminal_claim_cleared
check_round_outbox_terminal_claim_cleare.value: ("check_round_outbox"."published_at" is null and "check_round_outbox"."blocked_at" is null) or "check_round_outbox"."claim_token" is null

dns_record_history_state_candidate_consi.name: dns_record_history_state_candidate_consistent
dns_record_history_state_candidate_consi.value:
("dns_record_history_state"."candidate_answers" is null) = ("dns_record_history_state"."candidate_location_evidence" is null)
        and ("dns_record_history_state"."candidate_answers" is null) = ("dns_record_history_state"."candidate_first_observed_at" is null)

incident_action_events_payload_consisten.name: incident_action_events_payload_consistent
incident_action_events_payload_consisten.value:
(
        ("incident_action_events"."action" = 'SILENCED' and "incident_action_events"."silence_until" is not null and "incident_action_events"."note" is null)
        or ("incident_action_events"."action" = 'MANUALLY_RESOLVED' and "incident_action_events"."silence_until" is null)
        or ("incident_action_events"."action" in ('ACKNOWLEDGED', 'UNSILENCED') and "incident_action_events"."silence_until" is null and "incident_action_events"."note" is null)
      )

incidents_silence_consistent.name: incidents_silence_consistent
incidents_silence_consistent.value: num_nonnulls("incidents"."silenced_at", "incidents"."silenced_until", "incidents"."silenced_by_actor_id") in (0, 3) and ("incidents"."silenced_at" is null or "incidents"."silenced_until" > "incidents"."silenced_at")

monitor_configuration_versions_protocol_.name: monitor_configuration_versions_protocol_configuration
monitor_configuration_versions_protocol_.value:
(
        ("monitor_configuration_versions"."type"::text = 'HTTP' and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_host" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_port" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_record_type" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_warning_days" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."api_workflow" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."heartbeat" is null)
        or
        ("monitor_configuration_versions"."type"::text = 'TCP' and length(btrim("monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_host")) > 0 and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_port" between 1 and 65535 and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_record_type" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_warning_days" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."api_workflow" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."heartbeat" is null)
        or
        ("monitor_configuration_versions"."type"::text = 'DNS' and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_host" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_port" is null and length(btrim("monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_name")) > 0 and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_record_type" in ('A', 'AAAA', 'CNAME', 'MX', 'TXT', 'NS') and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_warning_days" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."api_workflow" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."heartbeat" is null)
        or
        ("monitor_configuration_versions"."type"::text = 'API_WORKFLOW' and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_host" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_port" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_record_type" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_warning_days" is null and jsonb_typeof("monitor_configuration_versions"."api_workflow") = 'object' and "monitor_configuration_versions"."heartbeat" is null)
        or
        ("monitor_configuration_versions"."type"::text = 'HEARTBEAT' and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_host" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_port" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_record_type" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_warning_days" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."api_workflow" is null and jsonb_typeof("monitor_configuration_versions"."heartbeat") = 'object')
        or
        ("monitor_configuration_versions"."type"::text = 'DOMAIN_EXPIRY' and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_host" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."tcp_port" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_name" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."dns_record_type" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_name" is not null and length(btrim("monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_name")) > 0 and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_warning_days" is not null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."domain_warning_days" between 1 and 365 and "monitor_configuration_versions"."api_workflow" is null and "monitor_configuration_versions"."heartbeat" is null)
      )

monitor_configuration_versions_status_po.name: monitor_configuration_versions_status_policy_shape
monitor_configuration_versions_status_po.value:
jsonb_typeof("monitor_configuration_versions"."status_policy") = 'object'
        and "monitor_configuration_versions"."status_policy"->>'type' in ('ANY_2XX', 'EXACT')
        and (
          "monitor_configuration_versions"."status_policy"->>'type' = 'ANY_2XX'
          or (
            jsonb_typeof("monitor_configuration_versions"."status_policy"->'statusCodes') = 'array'
            and jsonb_array_length("monitor_configuration_versions"."status_policy"->'statusCodes') > 0
            and not jsonb_path_exists(
              "monitor_configuration_versions"."status_policy",
              '$.statusCodes[*] ? (@.type() != "number" || @ != @.floor() || @ < 100 || @ > 599)'
            )
          )
        )

monitor_incident_state_multi_location_re.name: monitor_incident_state_multi_location_recovery_valid

        or

monitors_status_policy_shape.name: monitors_status_policy_shape
monitors_status_policy_shape.value:

        and "monitors"."status_policy"->>'type' in ('ANY_2XX', 'EXACT')
        and (
          "monitors"."status_policy"->>'type' = 'ANY_2XX'
          or (
            jsonb_typeof("monitors"."status_policy"->'statusCodes') = 'array'
            and jsonb_array_length("monitors"."status_policy"->'statusCodes') > 0
            and not jsonb_path_exists(
              "monitors"."status_policy",
              '$.statusCodes[*] ? (@.type() != "number" || @ != @.floor() || @ < 100 || @ > 599)'
            )
          )

notification_deliveries_eligible_idx.name: notification_deliveries_eligible_idx
notification_deliveries_eligible_idx.where: "notification_deliveries"."delivered_at" is null and "notification_deliveries"."dead_at" is null and "notification_deliveries"."suppressed_at" is null

notification_deliveries_terminal_claim_c.name: notification_deliveries_terminal_claim_cleared
notification_deliveries_terminal_claim_c.value: ("notification_deliveries"."delivered_at" is null and "notification_deliveries"."dead_at" is null and "notification_deliveries"."suppressed_at" is null) or "notification_deliveries"."claim_token" is null

notification_events_payload_contract.name: notification_events_payload_contract
notification_events_payload_contract.value:
jsonb_typeof("notification_events"."payload") = 'object'
        and "notification_events"."payload"->>'contractVersion' in ('1', '2')
        and "notification_events"."payload"->>'eventId' = "notification_events"."id"::text
        and "notification_events"."payload"->>'organizationId' = "notification_events"."organization_id"::text
        and "notification_events"."payload"->>'eventType' = "notification_events"."event_type"::text
        and (
          ("notification_events"."event_type"::text = 'TEST' and "notification_events"."payload"->>'contractVersion' = '1'
            and "notification_events"."monitor_id" is null and "notification_events"."incident_id" is null
            and "notification_events"."triggering_round_id" is null and "notification_events"."payload"->'channel' is not null)
          or
          ("notification_events"."event_type"::text <> 'TEST' and "notification_events"."monitor_id" is not null and "notification_events"."incident_id" is not null
            and "notification_events"."triggering_round_id" is not null
            and "notification_events"."payload"->>'triggeringRoundId' = "notification_events"."triggering_round_id"::text
            and (
              "notification_events"."payload"->>'contractVersion' = '1'
              or (
                "notification_events"."payload"->>'contractVersion' = '2'
                and "notification_events"."payload"->'incident'->>'groupKey' is not null
                and "notification_events"."payload"->'incident'->>'severity' in ('DEGRADED', 'DOWN')
              )
            ))
        )

probe_agent_enrollments_terminal_exclusi.name: probe_agent_enrollments_terminal_exclusive
probe_agent_enrollments_terminal_exclusi.value: not ("probe_agent_enrollments"."consumed_at" is not null and "probe_agent_enrollments"."revoked_at" is not null)

probe_execution_attempts_submission_cons.name: probe_execution_attempts_submission_consistent
probe_execution_attempts_submission_cons.value: ("probe_execution_attempts"."status" = 'SUBMITTED') = ("probe_execution_attempts"."submitted_at" is not null and "probe_execution_attempts"."submitted_engine_version" is not null)

projects_incident_escalation_steps_valid.name: projects_incident_escalation_steps_valid
projects_incident_escalation_steps_valid.value:
jsonb_typeof("projects"."incident_escalation_steps") = 'array'
        and jsonb_array_length("projects"."incident_escalation_steps") <= 3
        and not jsonb_path_exists(
          "projects"."incident_escalation_steps",
          '$[*] ? (@.type() != "object" || @.delayMinutes.type() != "number" || @.delayMinutes < 5 || @.delayMinutes > 10080 || @.delayMinutes != @.delayMinutes.floor() || (@.channelIds != null && @.channelIds.type() != "array"))'
        )
        and (
          jsonb_array_length("projects"."incident_escalation_steps") < 2
          or jsonb_path_match("projects"."incident_escalation_steps", '$[0].delayMinutes < $[1].delayMinutes')
        )
        and (
          jsonb_array_length("projects"."incident_escalation_steps") < 3
          or jsonb_path_match("projects"."incident_escalation_steps", '$[1].delayMinutes < $[2].delayMinutes')
        )

webhook_endpoint_versions_configuration.name: webhook_endpoint_versions_configuration
webhook_endpoint_versions_configuration.value:
(
        "webhook_endpoint_versions"."channel_type"::text = 'WEBHOOK'
        and length("webhook_endpoint_versions"."url") between 1 and 2048
        and jsonb_typeof("webhook_endpoint_versions"."signing_secret_envelope") = 'object'
        and "webhook_endpoint_versions"."recipient_emails" is null
        and "webhook_endpoint_versions"."slack_webhook_url_envelope" is null
      ) or (
        "webhook_endpoint_versions"."channel_type"::text = 'EMAIL'
        and "webhook_endpoint_versions"."url" is null
        and "webhook_endpoint_versions"."signing_secret_envelope" is null
        and jsonb_typeof("webhook_endpoint_versions"."recipient_emails") = 'array'
        and jsonb_array_length("webhook_endpoint_versions"."recipient_emails") between 1 and 20
        and "webhook_endpoint_versions"."slack_webhook_url_envelope" is null
      ) or (
        "webhook_endpoint_versions"."channel_type"::text = 'SLACK'
        and "webhook_endpoint_versions"."url" is null
        and "webhook_endpoint_versions"."signing_secret_envelope" is null
        and "webhook_endpoint_versions"."recipient_emails" is null
        and jsonb_typeof("webhook_endpoint_versions"."slack_webhook_url_envelope") = 'object'
      )
